items.exampleEn: Many students go overseas to study.
The queen wore a gold crown.
items.exampleZh: 女王戴著一頂金色的王冠。

items.exampleEn: The playground is closed today because of the rain.
items.exampleZh: 遊樂場今天因為下雨關閉。

items.exampleEn: There is an old mosque in the city center.
items.exampleZh: 市中心有一座古老的清真寺。

items.exampleEn: A king built this castle five hundred years ago.
items.exampleZh: 這座城堡是一位國王在五百年前建造的。

items.exampleEn: Many Pacific islands are small and beautiful.
items.exampleZh: 很多太平洋上的島嶼又小又美。

items.exampleEn: The queen visited our town last year.
items.exampleZh: 女王去年來過我們鎮上。

items.exampleEn: The car park was full, so we parked on the street.
items.exampleZh: 停車場滿了，所以我們把車停在路邊。

items.sentenceEn: Let's meet at the car park at six.
items.sentenceZh: 我們六點在停車場見面吧。

items.audioEn: The castle opens at nine, and the queen's crown is on the second floor.
items.audioZh: 城堡九點開放，女王的王冠在二樓。

items.sentenceEn: My cousin has worked overseas for three years.
items.sentenceZh: 我表哥在國外工作三年了。

items.sentenceEn: Kids, don't run in the car park!
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們，別在停車場裡跑！

items.stemEn: After school, the kids play football on the ____.
items.stemZh: 放學後，孩子們在操場上踢足球。

items.stemEn: We drove along the ____ coast for two days.
items.stemZh: 我們沿著太平洋海岸開了兩天車。

items.passageEn: Last month, we went on a school trip to an old castle by the sea. Long ago, the castle was the home of a queen. In one room, we saw her gold crown. Near the castle, there was a playground for children and a big car park for buses. On the way back, our teacher said, "Next year, we can go overseas!"
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們學校校外教學去了海邊的一座古堡。很久以前，這座城堡是一位女王的家。在其中一個房間裡，我們看到了她的金色王冠。城堡附近有一座兒童遊樂場和一個供遊覽車停的大停車場。回程的路上，老師說：「明年我們可以出國去！」

questions.questionZh: 這座城堡以前是誰的家？

items.promptZh: 這座清真寺有三百年的歷史了。
referenceEn: This mosque is three hundred years old.
This mosque is about three hundred years old.
rubricZh: 「有⋯年歷史」可寫例如 is three hundred years old

items.instructionZh: 用 castle 造一個句子，說說你去過或想去的城堡。
referenceEn: I want to visit an old castle in Europe.
We took many photos at the castle.
rubricZh: castle 是可數名詞（例如 a castle、an old castle）
時態配合句意（例如 want、took）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：「our school trip went to an old castle」主詞搭配生硬，較自然寫法 "On our school trip, we went to…" 或 "our school took us on a trip to…"。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last month, we went on a school trip to an old castle by the sea. Long ago, the castle was the home of a queen. In one room, we saw her gold crown. Near the castle, there was a playground for children and a big car park for buses. On the way back, our teacher said, \"Next year, we can go overseas!\""（原 "Last month, our school trip went to an old castle by the sea. The castle used to be the home of a queen. In one room, we saw her gold crown. Near the castle, there was a playground for children and a big car park for buses. On the way back, our teacher said, \"Next year, we can go overseas!\""）；主詞搭配改自然；同時依第③關 FIX 拿掉 used to（B1）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：中譯同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "上個月，我們學校校外教學去了海邊的一座古堡。很久以前，這座城堡是一位女王的家。在其中一個房間裡，我們看到了她的金色王冠。城堡附近有一座兒童遊樂場和一個供遊覽車停的大停車場。回程的路上，老師說：「明年我們可以出國去！」"（原 "上個月，我們學校校外教學去了海邊的一座古堡。這座城堡以前是一位女王的家。在其中一個房間裡，我們看到了她的金色王冠。城堡附近有一座兒童遊樂場和一個供遊覽車停的大停車場。回程的路上，老師說：「明年我們可以出國去！」"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：疑似：cousin 未示性別，譯「表哥」多加了資訊；可用「我表哥」以外的中性說法或接受此慣例（輕微）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 不改（語感類，執行長授權判斷）：中文沒有不分性別長幼又自然的 cousin 譯法（「表親」生硬），沿用「表哥」慣例；題目不考性別
